# Macrion 0.2.1

This release resolves a force-close issue when running scenarios with text detection on Android emulators.

## Fixes and refinements

- **Text detection emulator compatibility**: Disabled AVX, AVX2, AVX-512, and FMA instruction set optimizations when compiling the NCNN neural network library. This eliminates an Illegal Instruction (`SIGILL`) crash that force-closed the floating menu on Android emulators like BlueStacks when starting detection on scenarios containing text conditions.

## Installation

Download the APK matching your device. `arm64-v8a` is the usual choice for modern Android phones; use the universal APK if you are unsure.

Macrion is based on [Klick'r / Smart AutoClicker](https://github.com/Nain57/Smart-AutoClicker), and the existing Klick'r 4.0.1 feature set remains available. Back up important scenarios before upgrading and report problems through the repository's issue tracker.
